signatureVerification.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw request body
signatureVerification.secretSource: environment variable selected by --secret-env, default GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET

httpListener.githubPing: signed ping requests return 200 without writing a business delivery
httpListener.shutdown: SIGINT or SIGTERM stops the Bun server and closes SQLite
httpListener.packagedSmoke: Health GET returned 200 and a signed pull_request POST returned 202 on 127.0.0.1.

normalization.shaValidation: Repository is lowercased and all commit SHAs must be 40 hexadecimal characters.
normalization.review: Uses review.commit_id, falling back to pull_request.head.sha only when the review commit is absent.

idempotency.logicalEventKey: event type, normalized repository, PR number, head SHA and raw payload hash

verification.schemaMigrationTests: v1 through v8 migrate to v9

scope.httpReceiver: implemented for local Bun HTTP use
scope.ciFailureTriage: minimal task materialization implemented; log analysis and automatic rerun not implemented
scope.actualGitHubDelivery: Signature behavior is verified with deterministic signed payloads. A deployed webhook secret and public callback endpoint have not been configured.
